description: This Java class 'AttachmentService' provides functionality for uploading, listing, and downloading email attachments, managing file storage on disk and metadata in a database.

classes.name: AttachmentService
classes.description: Service class for handling email attachment operations including upload, list, and download.

classes.name: AttachmentService.DownloadResource
classes.description: Inner class representing a downloadable attachment resource with metadata.

methods.name: AttachmentService
methods.description: Constructor initializing storage directory and repositories.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads a list of files as attachments for a specific email owned by a user.

methods.name: listByEmail
methods.description: Lists all attachments associated with a specific email for a user.

methods.name: loadForDownload
methods.description: Loads an attachment as a resource for download if owned by the user.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts an Attachment entity to its DTO representation.
